payload.reason: The evidence indicates that PARENT correlates better with human judgments compared to existing metrics, but does not specify the exact degree of improvement or comparison values.

claims.text: PARENT correlates with human judgments better than existing text generation metrics.
PARENT is either competitive or better than other metrics in terms of average correlation to human ratings across grammaticality, fluency, and semantics.
Both variants of PARENT are significantly better than other metrics in making the same judgments as humans.
